name: commitmsg-formatter
description: Validates and normalizes git commit messages before Bash runs them: 50-character subject opening with one gitmoji, no colon, body wrapped at 72, no editor-opening forms.

subjectMax.title: Subject length limit
subjectMax.description: Maximum subject length in characters (Unicode code points, so a gitmoji with a variation selector counts as two). Values below 10 fall back to 50.

bodyWrap.title: Body wrap width
bodyWrap.description: Body lines longer than this are re-wrapped. Values below 20 fall back to 72.

requireGitmoji.title: Require a gitmoji
requireGitmoji.description: The subject must open with exactly one glyph from the official gitmoji list. Off: no emoji is required, and a leading emoji may be any one emoji.

disallowedPatterns.title: Disallowed patterns
disallowedPatterns.description: Regular expressions, one per line. A commit message (subject or body) matching any of them is denied. Empty: none.
